scope: Astronaut vehicles in the eight 2007 Mars Mission sets, including human side builds and detachable scouts. No 2008 vehicles, alien craft or static bases.

entries.name: Eagle command shuttle
entries.cue: Long amber canopy, swept white wings, twin orange engines
entries.rights: LEGO Group. Reference study only; not a game texture.

entries.name: Mothership-assault defence sled
entries.cue: Twin runners, open control seats, four orange launch tubes
entries.rights: LEGO Group. Reference study only; not a game texture.

entries.name: MX-71 Recon Dropship
entries.cue: Sloping front wings, long spine, three rear engines and amber cargo pods
entries.rights: LEGO Group. Reference study only; not a game texture.

entries.name: Recon drilling rover
entries.cue: Six orange wheels, curved amber cab, rear drill and roll bar
entries.rights: LEGO Group. Reference study only; not a game texture.

entries.name: Alien Strike mining truck
entries.cue: Four orange wheels, curved amber cab, articulated vertical drill
entries.rights: LEGO Group. Reference study only; not a game texture.

entries.name: MT-31 Trike
entries.cue: Two huge front wheels, single trailing wheel, narrow white fuselage
entries.rights: LEGO Group. Reference study only; not a game texture.

entries.name: MX-11 Astro Fighter
entries.cue: Small swept wings, bubble canopy, single over-cockpit instrument
entries.rights: LEGO Group. Reference study only; not a game texture.

entries.name: MT-51 Claw-Tank
entries.cue: Twin orange front tracks, rear wheels, raised cab and reaching claw
entries.rights: LEGO Group. Reference study only; not a game texture.

entries.name: MT-101 Armored Drilling Unit
entries.cue: Six oversized wheels, sloped armoured cab, raised drilling boom
entries.rights: LEGO Group. Reference study only; not a game texture.

entries.name: MT-101 transport scout
entries.cue: Detachable wedge flyer, twin amber cargo pods and tall split tail
entries.rights: LEGO Group. Reference study only; not a game texture.

entries.name: MT-101 scout bike
entries.cue: Two inline orange wheels beneath a compact amber roll cage
entries.rights: LEGO Group. Reference study only; not a game texture.
